entities.name: Nikos Konstantopoulos

entities.summary: Nikos Konstantopoulos is a Greek politician, former member of the Hellenic Parliament and former president of the left-wing Synaspismos. His daughter, Zoe Konstantopoulou, until September 2015, was the Speaker of the Hellenic Parliament.
